comparison.objective: Configure a control panel from a printed setup sheet and perform a two-hand start.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual instruction following, switches/dial/sliders manipulation, and synchronized button pressing.
comparison.success_condition: All P2 settings are correct and START plus green are pressed within 0.5 seconds and held for two seconds; forbidden controls invalidate the run.
comparison.reason: Tests panel configuration and synchronized control activation, with no comparable mechanical fracture, impact-force control, or fragment handling.
